svg.title: Species lost from forests
svg.desc: Five fact files: the Guam kingfisher (extinct in the wild), the Formosan clouded leopard (declared extinct), the South Island kōkako and the kouprey (both critically endangered, possibly extinct), and the Alagoas foliage-gleaner (extinct). Each is shown alive in its forest, then the card turns grey, freezes and is stamped. A list of other extinct forest species scrolls past, ending on the word EXTINCT. Simplified: Each stamp gives the status on the IUCN Red List (or, for the Formosan clouded leopard, the 2013 declaration by researchers in Taiwan), so not every stamp says only EXTINCT. Three cards carry a real photograph (Wikimedia Commons, credited on the card; see assets/photos/CREDITS.md). The kouprey and the Alagoas foliage-gleaner have none because no openly licensed photo was found. The drain to grey is a saturation blend over the card (mix-blend-mode), the nearest native SVG equivalent of a colour grade.
